_note: Block notes of pyramid, babel_tower, ending and unused actors whose shipped header is wrong or hides the flag logic the code runs. Each note describes the code as it is now; flags are named by index and scenes by id.

blockNote: Falling orb of the Pyramid trickle area (scene $D4). The spawn byte picks the latch: flag = (spawn byte >> 1) + $80, so the first group (spawn byte #E5, tiles (22,1B), (24,1B), (22,1D), (24,1D)) uses $F2 and the second group (#E7, tiles (0C,4B), (0E,4B), (0C,4D), (0E,4D)) uses $F3. The four orbs of a group share the flag.

At load: with the flag set the orb is a fallen prop (priority minimum, collision cleared). With the flag clear it waits every frame for body bank $97 with animation index 1 on the player, characterForm 1 (Freedan) and the player within BranchIfPlayerNear #0C. On that trigger it sets the flag, waits 179 ticks, waits a random delay, moves up by $100, plays the fall animation with sound $1515 and ends in the fallen state. The orbs do not fall on a timer and do not damage.

Upper Vader barrier of the Pyramid (scene $D6), a sword-hit toggle for two walls of solid cells: x $34-$39 on rows y $2B-$2C and on rows y $4B-$4C. At spawn the rows y $2B-$2C are solid and the barrier holds its hit points at $7FFF. A hit while the shared scratch flag $0F is set is ignored. Otherwise the hit sets $0F, shows frame #11, marks rows y $4B-$4C solid and counts the word at slot offset $1060 + $26 up from $FE00 one step per frame; at 0 it clears rows y $2B-$2C, plays sound $1515, shows frame #12 and clears $0F.
$0F is the interlock with pyD6_vader_barrier_lower. The actor does not test characterForm.

Lower Vader barrier of the Pyramid (scene $D6), the counterpart of pyD6_vader_barrier_upper: same hit-toggle with the shared scratch flag $0F as interlock and the same counter word at slot offset $1060 + $26. A hit while $0F is set is ignored. Otherwise the hit sets $0F, marks rows y $2B-$2C solid and counts the word down from its current value to $FE00 one step per frame; at $FE00 it clears rows y $4B-$4C, plays sound $1515, shows frame #12 and clears $0F.
The actor does not test characterForm.

Jackal of the Pyramid puzzle room (scene $CD). At spawn it sets scratch $0E (Lola's Melody is playable from then on) and waits for the six hieroglyph stone flags $C2-$C7. If $BB is set (the scene has played) it becomes a solid prop at tile (09,0B). Otherwise it clears $0E, sets $0F and waits for the player in tiles (05,09)-(0A,0B).

Entry: locks the player, starts music #1B, marks five cells solid and prints 'Walk to the left without a sound!!'. When the player reaches tiles (03,09)-(04,0D) it swaps the solid cells, prints 'There, that's good. Don't move!!', sets scratch $02, prints two more dialog strings, turns the player back into Will through sE6_gaia.Transform_ShadowToWill or Transform_FreedanToWill when the player is in another form, unlocks and sets $0E again.

Loop: scratch $03 set (the left flame statue fired) starts the panic path code_08B956: clears $0E, spawns 12 flame sprites and the child code_08BA04, which prints 'Wa-a-a-a-ah!!!!' and 'Kara...Kara...', sets scratch $04, $05 and $06, sets persistent $BB and clears $0F. Scratch $0D set makes the Jackal quiet. Otherwise the interact handler prints the knife line.
The room has no detection or restart: the only failure state is the panic path.

Pair of flame statues of the Pyramid puzzle room (scene $CD), the receiver of Lola's Melody. Both statues are solid, wait for scratch $01 (set when the melody is used) and fire once: the left statue (pyCD_flame_statue) waits 29 ticks, plays sound $1919, spawns the camera drift, shows frame #1D, spawns the flame stream code_08B7D0 and sets scratch $03; the right statue (pyCD_flame_statue2) waits 89 ticks, shows frame #9D and spawns its flame stream.
code_08B7D0 spawns five flame sprites of pyCD_jackal.code_08B804 and ends. Scratch $03 is read by pyCD_jackal, which starts its panic path. The statues do not fire periodically.

Explorer of the Pyramid puzzle room (scene $CD): a solid NPC whose interact handler prints 'There are traps scattered around to prevent entry. There's a booby trap in this room that responds to sound.....So don't make any noise...'. At spawn it dies when any of the stone flags $C2-$C7 is set or when the player holds one of the items $1E-$23.

Portal to the Mummy Queen in the main Pyramid scene ($CC). At spawn it dies when $FC (the Mummy Queen's Mystic Statue was collected) is set. Otherwise it waits for $D1 (the hieroglyph puzzle was solved), then becomes an interactable: 'The mummified queen of the Pyramid appears. Quit / Jump in'. 'Jump in' sets bit $2000 of the player's flags $10, spawns py_death_particle, sets gfxCacheIdxA and gfxCacheIdxB to $0303 and queues scene $DD at (00F8,01B0).

Kara as the follower of Will in the Tower of Babel (placed in scenes $DE, $DF, $E0, $E1 and $E3). It dies at load when $D4 (Kara follows Will) is clear. In scene $E0 with $0178 set (the Neo Fanger fight was won) it clears $D4, locks the player, waits 29 ticks, prints 'Kara's not here... Where did she go...?', unlocks and dies. Otherwise it spawns EscortFollowPathTracker at the player's position, follows the player and spawns the effect sprite code_09870C each time bit $2000 of the player's field $0E changes state.
$D4 is set by btDF_kara (scene $DF) and by btE3_kara (scene $E3).

Crystal gate A of the Babel middle floors (scene $E0): marks the cells (71,38) and (72,38) solid, spawns two bt_static_sprite crystals and waits for $0175, which btF2_neo_castoth (scene $F2) sets when the Neo Castoth fight is won. It then clears the two cells and dies.

Crystal gate B of the Babel middle floors (scene $E0): marks the cells (0D,28) and (0E,28) solid, spawns two bt_static_sprite crystals and waits for $0176, which btF3_neo_viper (scene $F3) sets when the Neo Viper fight is won. It then clears the two cells and dies.

Crystal gate C of the Babel middle floors (scene $E0): marks the cells (49,18) and (4A,18) solid, spawns two bt_static_sprite crystals and waits for $0177, which btF4_neo_female_vampire (scene $F4) sets when the Neo Vampires fight is won. It then clears the two cells and dies.

Crystal gate D of the Babel middle floors (scene $E0): marks the cells (15,08) and (16,08) solid, spawns two bt_static_sprite crystals and waits for $0178, which btF5_neo_fanger (scene $F5) sets when the Neo Fanger fight is won. It then clears the two cells and dies. The gate waits on its own flag only. $0178 is also read by btDE_kara_missing.

Crystal gate of the Babel upper floors (scene $E3): marks the cells (29,38) and (2A,38) solid, spawns two bt_static_sprite crystals and waits for $0179, which btF6_neo_queen (scene $F6) sets when the Neo Queen fight is won, just before it queues scene $E3. It then clears the two cells and dies.

Spirit at the Babel exterior (scene $E2): a solid NPC with the interact handler 'You were brought back to save Earth. I'll take you to the top floor.', which sets scratch $01. The main script waits for $01 and then locks the player ($CFFC), moves to the player, spawns the child code_099899, hands the player the script btE1_comet_soon.code_0997B7 (the ride), sets bit $0800 of the player's flags, rises while y is at least $90, waits 59 ticks, moves to (0188,0110), kills the child, sets scratch $04 (read by the ride script) and unlocks. The actor tests no persistent flag.

Epilogue of the ending (scene $E5), two loads chosen by persistent $DB. $DB clear: first half: Kara 'What's happened to the comet...?', Will's father 'The comet's power has disappeared...', the strange voice 'Yes. The world is awakened.', handshake with code_0BD539 and the puppets code_0BD4F7 through scratch $02, then 'Will: Mother?!' with the long family dialog; it sets $DB and queues scene $90. $DB set (code_0BD374): second half: 'Will: Why do you two know the future?', handshakes through scratch $03, $04 and $05 with the puppets and the player routine loc_0BD494, Kara's 'Will... Come here....' and Will's answer; it queues scene $89.
The scene chain from the Dark Gaia fight is $E8 -> $E5 -> $90 -> $E5 -> $89 -> $F7 -> $F0. This scene does not start the credits itself.
Unreferenced thinker that waits for flag byte $F5 to be set and then runs palette animation #65 every frame. $F5 is set only by unused_mode7_boss. Never spawned in any scene or cutscene.
